sourceTacticNo.description: The source's own tactic number, which is the id's number on every record.

name.description: The tactic's title, verbatim. The measured range is 18-62 characters.

domain.description: The taxonomy's domain heading the tactic is numbered under, verbatim. The opening framing table lists five domains; the tactics are numbered under these four.
enum: Cognitive Focus and Flow State Engineering

diagnostic.description: The source's Cognitive Friction Diagnostic, verbatim. Its measured range is 121-239 characters; this bound leaves room for the longest without admitting a paragraph.

diagnosticSize.description: The front's diagnostic point size, fixed per card in the layout map. The measured front budget holds 121-239 characters at 7.5-9 pt.

schematic.description: The line the card prints under the figure, in the form '<Family> at <unit> <mark> of <divisions>'. The same numbers are in figure.parametricParams, and the deck's test parses this line against them.

procedure.description: The numbered procedure, this deck's compression of the source's Implementation Algorithm. The compression rule is on the rules file: it may drop explanation but not add a claim, change a number or omit a bound.

trap.description: The failure trap, this deck's compression of the source's The Failure Trap. The source's own text is trapFull.

origin.description: Two tiers and no third. The source names a person in the tactic title on eleven cards; those carry the name and nothing else. Every other card carries the honest line. There is deliberately no year, work or publication property: the source gives none, and a field the source cannot back is a citation this deck would be vouching for.

divisions.description: How many parts the structure has. The largest is the 90-day pruning window; the smallest is 2.

mark.description: Which part is the move. The layout map's label states it, and the test requires the label's numbers to match these two.

procedureFull.description: The source's Implementation Algorithm, verbatim after the declared rendering table. Printed in the rules file and the domain resource. Measured range 350-629 characters: the shortest is TAC-19's four-step RICE ranking, and the bound admits it rather than padding an algorithm to reach a round number.

setupFull.description: The source's Plain-Text Implementation, verbatim after the declared rendering table. Printed in the rules file and the domain resource. Measured range 136-579 characters; three of them are markdown tables.

trapFull.description: The source's The Failure Trap, verbatim after the declared rendering table. Printed in the rules file and the domain resource. Measured range 112-215 characters.

sourceNote.description: The named source defect that prints with this card, if any. Two cards carry one: the setup whose line breaks were lost, and the algorithm whose fifth step is glued onto the fourth.
